properties.name: encoding
properties.description: Set or get the output encoding.

properties.name: byteOrderMark
properties.description: Determine whether or not to write the byte order mark

properties.name: indent
properties.description: Enable or disable auto indent mode.

properties.name: standalone
properties.description: Set or get the standalone document declaration.

properties.name: omitXMLDeclaration
properties.description: Determine whether or not to omit the XML declaration.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Set or get the xml version info.

properties.name: disableOutputEscaping
properties.description: When enabled, the writer no longer escapes out its input when writing it out.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all writer buffers forcing the writer to write to the underlying output object
